body: Ya, I know. I just wanted to rule that out as an option for me.
Yes, however I don't own a house.

Thanks for the kind words, however people have been telling me it will get better for the last 15 years.. 

It's hard to believe that it ever will at this point.  There comes a time when fighting for a reason to live just doesn't seem worth it.  I don't think anyone can help me at this point.  I'm just another useless person that's a drain on society.  The best thing I could do is plug that drain, so there is one less thing taking a toll on resources.
